summary: Defines an open GPU substrate stack using TFT dimensional primitives, an open rendering layer, and AMD-friendly execution primitives. Provides three aligned views: functional (TFT.OpenGPU.Stack), structural (TFT.Substrate.Execution.Rendering), and market-facing (OpenSubstrate GPU Stack).

A_TFT_OpenGPU_Stack.purpose: Functional description of an open, RTT-aligned GPU stack with TFT as the substrate.

layers.substrate: TFT dimensional primitives, resonance-aware operators, hidden-view intent.
layers.rendering: Open rendering layer (Vulkan/WebGPU/custom), state-to-view mapping, client-side reconstruction.
layers.execution: AMD-friendly GPU primitives (ROCm/VCE/SR-IOV), cycles, memory, vGPU slices.

B_TFT_Substrate_Execution_Rendering.purpose: Structural decomposition of the stack expressed as substrate → rendering → execution.
B_TFT_Substrate_Execution_Rendering.substrate_layer: Dimensional intent, hidden view, RTT primitives, wrapped draw operators.
B_TFT_Substrate_Execution_Rendering.rendering_layer: Scene/viewport abstraction, materials, meshes, lights, reconstruction semantics.
B_TFT_Substrate_Execution_Rendering.execution_layer: Kernels, tiles, warps, GPU cycles, VRAM, virtualization primitives.

C_OpenSubstrate_GPU_Stack.purpose: Market-facing description of the stack as an open alternative to NVIDIA’s closed primitive ecosystem.
C_OpenSubstrate_GPU_Stack.substrate: TFT primitives as the differentiator; RDP/Cloud PC remoting via primitive streams.
C_OpenSubstrate_GPU_Stack.gpu_stack: Tiered vGPU for Cloud PCs, smooth remote desktops/apps, compatible with repurposed mining rigs.

alignment.inverted_star: Substrate primitives form the hidden structural view; rendering and execution form the visible view.
alignment.ue6_integration: Optional alignment with UE6-style rendering primitives (scene graph, materials, GPU pipelines).
alignment.rdp_extension: TFT primitive stream can be inserted into RDP via RDPEGFX or custom virtual channel.

opportunities.amd_partnership: AMD can adopt TFT substrate primitives as an open alternative to NVIDIA’s closed execution stack.
opportunities.cloud_pc: Cloud PC tiers map directly to vGPU slices; TFT primitives ensure smooth remote rendering.
opportunities.open_gpu_future: Defines a path toward an open GPU substrate stack independent of NVIDIA’s proprietary primitives.
